description: JavaScript code for TinyMCE plugin handling table row editing, including UI initialization, row updates, style changes, and background image management.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the table row editing dialog, populates form fields with current row attributes, and sets up UI elements.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Performs updates on table rows based on user-selected action: single row, all rows, odd/even rows.

methods.name: updateRow
methods.description: Updates attributes and styles of a specific table row element, possibly changing its parent node if row type changes.

methods.name: changedBackgroundImage
methods.description: Updates the style attribute with a new background image URL based on form input.

methods.name: changedStyle
methods.description: Parses the style string and updates form fields for background image, height, and background color.

methods.name: changedSize
methods.description: Updates the height style based on form input.

methods.name: changedColor
methods.description: Updates the background color style based on form input.
